source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: D230909 contains a nonblocking concern that confirmFolderUpload has no caller and an author response pointing to platform code. At the separately inspected Gecko revision, HTMLInputElement folder-mode handling obtains the prompt-collection service, passes its browsing context and directory name to ConfirmFolderUpload, checks the status and stops when confirmed is false. This proves that bounded platform call site, not a concrete Thunderbird add-on route or runtime reachability. Do not infer dead code from only comm-local callers. The accepted comm method keeps delayed Upload and default Cancel. Gecko and comm were not built as a verified pair.
title: Folder-upload confirmation has a platform file-picker caller
